[SWS_DM_00145] Allow only one simultaneous clear
DTC
operation for one
DiagnosticMemoryDestination
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04117
⌈
If a
Diagnostic Client
is clearing the DTCs of a
DiagnosticMemoryDestina-
tion
the DM shall lock the clear DTC operation for all other clients requesting to clear
the DTCs of the same
DiagnosticMemoryDestination
.
⌋
